indicator_name: Monetary survey of the banking system (depository corporations), history from 1997 (NBK page records)
description: Монетарный обзор по банковской системе (история с 1997 г., данные страницы НБК)
unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous month (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Монетарный обзор по банковской системе» (records JSON), month-end stocks from 1997-12 dated the first day of the next month. Item BS.<NBK key>. BS.i_a_r_nb_f_o = CB.n_d_a_r_non_banking + ODC.r_f_n_b_f_i and BS claims on local government, public and non-state nonfinancial organisations, NPISH and households = CB «остальная экономика» + the ODC lines, on every month from 2002-11-01 (enforced; 2001-12..2002-09 hold ~2 977 mln in NBFIs in the NBK survey and in the rest of the economy here). i_a = its published lines only through 2009-02-01 (the NBK's unpublished line after that).
